result.instructions: Tools for Xodo Sign, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my documents are still waiting for other people to sign?"; "Show me the documents that were completed this month."; "Send a signing reminder for document j6yMcaF2gQAIIQ to signer 1.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Xodo Sign data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eversign_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eversign_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eversign_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eversign_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eversign_list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses
tools.description: List the businesses (workspaces) the signed-in account can use, with business_id, name and whether each is the primary business. Call this first to find a business_id. Xodo Sign API: GET /business.

tools.name: eversign_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents in a business, filtered by status (for example waiting_for_others or completed). Each entry includes document_hash, title and status flags. Xodo Sign API: GET /document?type=...

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

tools.name: eversign_get_document
tools.title: Get document or template
tools.description: Get one document or template in full: signers (with signer ids and status), fields, files, dates and flags. Works for templates too. Xodo Sign API: GET /document?document_hash=...

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

tools.name: eversign_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the templates in a business (active, archived or drafts). Xodo Sign API: GET /document?type=templates.

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

type.description: Which templates to list. Default: templates.

tools.name: eversign_get_final_pdf_url
tools.title: Get final PDF link
tools.description: Get the download link of the final signed PDF of a completed document. Returns the link, not the file. Set audit_trail to include the audit trail. Xodo Sign API: GET /download_final_document?url_only=1.

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

audit_trail.description: Attach the audit trail to the PDF. Default: false.

tools.name: eversign_send_reminder
tools.title: Send signing reminder
tools.description: Send an email reminder to one signer of a pending document. The signer is emailed at once; a reminder cannot be unsent. Xodo Sign API: POST /send_reminder.

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

tools.name: eversign_cancel_document
tools.title: Cancel document
tools.description: Cancel a pending document: no signer can sign it after this. Cancelling does not delete it. Xodo Sign API: DELETE /document?cancel=1.

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.

tools.name: eversign_trash_document
tools.title: Move document to trash
tools.description: Move a document to the trash. Pending documents must be cancelled first, and completed or draft documents must be trashed before deletion. Xodo Sign API: DELETE /document?trash=1.

business_id.description: Business to act on (numeric business_id). Default: the business chosen at sign-in. See eversign_list_businesses.
